# Third-party notices

The build bundles Pi Durable, Pi AI, Chord, TypeBox, partial-json, abort-controller and event-target-shim. It uses quickjs-emscripten and QuickJS as runtime dependencies. `scripts/licenses.mjs` copies published license files into `dist/licenses` and emits a version manifest.

The Earendil Works 1.1.0 npm packages declare MIT but omit their license files. `earendil-pi-LICENSE` is the unmodified upstream root license fetched from:
https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/eba849739511223c51a62bbd7e3f1c00f99fb1d0/LICENSE

PiDurableKit is credited as inspiration in README, NOTICE and the playground. Its Swift code is not included in this project. All upstream names are credited to their respective authors; no affiliation or endorsement is implied.
